_comment: konnect's app links, for site/.well-known/ (deploy/site/build.mjs; site/README.md, 'konnect's app links'). Lee fills these in: apple_team_id, the Apple Developer team's 10-character id; and for each Android package, the SHA-256 fingerprints of the certificates it is signed with (Play App Signing's app signing key, and the upload key for builds installed outside Play), as AA:BB:… in upper case. Until apple_team_id is set, the build publishes no apple-app-site-association; until a package has a fingerprint, assetlinks.json leaves it out, and with none, isn't published. A value that isn't one fails the build.
